(count by (instance) (mssql_log_reuse_wait{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc!~"NOTHING|"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0))

panels.description: One row per bad database (state != ONLINE). Explains Bad DBs in Per-Server Rollup. 0=ONLINE 1=RESTORING 2=RECOVERING 3=RECOVERY_PENDING 4=SUSPECT 5=EMERGENCY 6=OFFLINE. If system DBs look wrong while SQL is up, redeploy mssql_standard.
panels.title: Bad Databases - detail (Server + Database)
